tasks.title: Adversarial verifier statement/transcript binding regression tests
tasks.acceptance: Cross-profile, malformed proof, altered commitment layout and wrong trusted-verifier parameters rejected; negative cases count zero target effects; document exact tested code.

tasks.title: Remote sandbox target plus durable two-controller reconciliation
tasks.acceptance: Separated controllers and target; lost ACK, concurrent operations, crash, stale version and UNKNOWN tested; at most one target effect and no blind retry.

tasks.title: Two real-format synthetic issuer provenance adapters
tasks.acceptance: Versioned issuer roles and trust registry, verified commitments, signatures, source omissions and revocation; zero effects on invalid inputs.

tasks.title: Independent third-party cryptographic audit
tasks.acceptance: Independent reviewer validates mathematical statement, implementation, leakage, parsing and side channels; internal agent review is not sufficient.

tasks.title: Threat model for production IAM and operational resilience
tasks.acceptance: Document reviewed mTLS/IAM/KMS/backup requirements, tenant isolation and production NO-GO until exercised.

tasks.title: Equivalent-statement Microsoft Vega comparative measurement
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent signatures, statements, environment and boundaries; otherwise separate comparisons, never a record claim.

tasks.title: CPU/GPU/PQ research feasibility and resource budget
tasks.acceptance: No GPU benchmark without GPU receipt independently verified; full PQ chain required, no signature-only relabeling; cost and limits explicit.
